title: 2190. Slice and Update a List

Slice and Update a List

Problem Statement
Read a list of integers and an integer x. Print some slices of the list, then add x to the list, sort it and print it.
Description
Read a list of integers and then an integer x. Print the first three items of the list, the last three items of the list, and every second item of the list (starting from the first item). After that, add x at the end of the list, sort the list in increasing order and print the list.
Input Description
The first line contains the integers of the list, separated by single spaces. (5 to 20 integers, each between -1000 and 1000) The second line contains the integer x. (-1000 <= x <= 1000)
Output Description
Print 4 lines. Print each result as a list in square brackets, with the numbers separated by a comma and a space, for example [1, 2, 3]. Line 1: the first three items. Line 2: the last three items. Line 3: every second item, starting from the first. Line 4: the list after adding x and sorting. The first three lines are for the original list, before x is added.
Sample Input
10 20 30 40 50 60 70
35
Sample Output
[10, 20, 30]
[50, 60, 70]
[10, 30, 50, 70]
[10, 20, 30, 35, 40, 50, 60, 70]
